fields.title: 📖 Athar refutation: The Qurʾān is not created
fields.body:
🖋️ **Imām Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Imām Aḥmad said: ‘The Qurʾān is Allah’s speech and is not created.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This statement refutes the Jahmiyyah and all who make Allah’s speech into a creation. The speech of Allah is His attribute.

immutable.source: 📝 Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, Uṣūl as-Sunnah, Grundsatz: al-Qurʾān Kalām Allah ghayr makhlūq.
